title: 原题所称 INS018_055 会在 2030 年前后获得 FDA 批准吗？
Will the drug called INS018_055 in the source gain FDA approval by 2030?
rules: 题名写“INS018_055 by 2030”，正文仅介绍进入 II 期，未明确具体日历截止与完整批准证据口径。
The title says “INS018_055 by 2030”; the description only discusses phase-II entry and leaves the precise cutoff and approval evidence underspecified.
interpretation: 论文使用 ISM001-055／rentosertib 名称，原题拼写差异保持可见；不能仅凭题名自动认定身份。
The paper uses ISM001-055/rentosertib; the market’s differing spelling remains visible and requires identity confirmation.

summary: 此题关注指定候选药的未来批准。首先需核对原题名称，再区分已有 IIa 期结果与未来 FDA 决定。
This predicts approval of a named candidate; first confirm the source spelling, then distinguish phase-2a results from a future FDA decision.
checklist: 核对 INS018_055 与论文药物名称及注册号。
Verify the source spelling against paper and registry.
查看 FDA 实际批准决定，而非试验阶段。
Check actual FDA decisions, not trial stage.
查看创建者对 2030 截止的澄清。

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: 论文和注册号能够帮助核对候选药身份与已有临床试验，但并不保证后续成功或批准。原题参与较少且日期简略，页面同时保留这些限制与真实历史成交。
The paper and registry help identify candidate and trials but do not guarantee later success or approval. Thin participation and an imprecise deadline accompany the actual history.
gap: 保留名称与截止不明确的提示，不由本站修补规则。
Retain naming/deadline ambiguity rather than repairing source rules.

title: AI 分子设计与临床证据
AI molecular design and clinical evidence
principle: AI 参与需要论文、专利或开发方记录支持。先导化合物、候选药、临床试验与上市批准是不同阶段；主要终点、对照和随访决定试验可回答的问题。
AI contribution needs papers, patents or developer records. Leads, candidates, trials and approval are separate stages; endpoints, controls and follow-up define trial evidence.
example: Rentosertib IIa 期随机入组 71 人并观察 12 周，主要终点为治疗期间不良事件。它既不是全部 AI 药物的验证，也不是 FDA 批准证明。
Rentosertib’s phase 2a randomized 71 people over 12 weeks, with treatment-emergent adverse events primary. It does not validate all AI drugs or establish FDA approval.
